articles.title: The First Black Woman in Space: Mae Jemison's Amazing Journey
articles.summary: On September 12, 1992, Mae Jemison became the first Black woman to fly into space. She spent 8 days on the space shuttle Endeavour and ran 44 science experiments. She was also a doctor and an engineer!

articles.title: Tiny Sound Waves Could Save Quantum Computers
articles.summary: Scientists at Harvard found a new way to protect fragile quantum information using microscopic sound waves called phonons. This could help build smaller, more powerful quantum computers.

articles.title: Where Have All the Wasps Gone? Scientists Are Worried
articles.summary: This summer, wasps are mysteriously missing in the UK. Scientists think extreme heat waves may be to blame. Wasps are important for ecosystems, so their absence is a big concern.
